notes.title: Night Club - Character Faces
notes.notes:
I have been working on the face designs for the characters in the Night Club scene ːsteamhappyː

The character faces are generated and shaped with a base model that has facial blendshapes, this allows me to shape the face any way I like without having to lock the model down to one look. 

This does however cause a reduction in overall detail in the face (depth, wrinkles, etc.). I am still looking into a way to have overall better facial detail.

notes.title: Title Recover and Re-work
notes.notes:
To give you an idea of what I started from and what it became, this is the old mockup for the title screen and is basically where i had to re-start building the scene from:

OLD TITLE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=biF2w0gfSpc

And without further ado I present to you the new Unity 5.6 version:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8DIvuppoF58

Some months back I had a computer crash and my computer was down for a few months, once I finally got things back up and running I was unable to recover the previous title screen design for the game. 

Since then I tried various ways to recover the scene but never found a good way to do it, so about a week or so ago I started re-building the scene back to it's previous beautiful setup! ːsteamhappyː It's not exactly as it was but it's pretty darn close! (maybe a bit better!?!)

LOST TITLE SCENE:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=djhHe1l_3n4

Since i was at it I went ahead and re-coded all of the UI interactions and functionality, coding can be funny because when you do it for so long you learn a lot of different tricks to do various things. So when you look back at your old code, the feeling of "I should re-do this" is definitely there, better functionality, more fluid interactions, there's no down side!

This is just a small step in development but in due time i'll have plenty more updates to share!

Until next time ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Latest News!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, sorry about the late response to your posts, steam doesn't notify me of new comments or discussions so i'll need to find a better way of checking on things here.

"Where's the website?"
Due to certain circumstances the website was removed but another one will replace it in the future.

"Any Updates?"
For a while there I was in the red financially and going through a very rough time, only within the past few months have things turned around for me and I am able to make time for both client work and game development. 

Does this mean the game will be pushed to the side? Of course not, I am still working on it but ever so slowly, while I stabilize my situation and get a nice work schedule back in order, I do ask for your patience.

"Release Date Changed?"
Unfortunately the first episode is not quiet ready yet and there are still many things i'd like to do prior to releasing it, even though the mocap company we made an agreement said I would be able to use their equipment for the making of realistic animations, they decided to not hold up their end of the bargain and so I am now working on purchasing my own mocap suit.

As mentioned I plan on getting a better work schedule so i can work on the game more and if things progress nicely i'll be able to release Episode One prior to October next year.

"What's being worked on?"
Currently I am working on upgrading the project into a later version of the game engine i use to really utilize and implement the best features the game can have. Among other things, smoothing out the gameplay mechanics is among the top things being worked on.

Once things progress a bit more voice actors will be called in to voice over the characters, at that point I could say Episode One should be about 50 - 75% complete.

"So.. what about the people who pre-ordered?"
Everyone who pre-ordered has been saved to a purchased list and will of course be notified once Episode One has released, pre-order customers will receive their steam key(s) and any extra goodies that might be available at that time.


Just a small reminder, I am a one person team and am working on this alone, a lot of people think a team is working on the game and I definitely take that as a compliment, hopefully you can understand one person can only do so much hehe

Thanks for all of your support and patience during the development of "Alone Without Her"!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Release pushed back, our apologies
notes.notes:
Due to certain circumstances I will have to push back the release by 6 months or so, I have been working hard on really polishing the mechanics for the game, implementing new features, re-working and building new play areas and many other things. While everything is coming together I ask that you please have patience and understand I am only one person, I am working on it! ^_^

In the meantime I have a lot of updates that I will be announcing soon so look forward to those, progression continues!

Thanks again for your patience and support of Alone Without Her.

notes.title: Thank you to all the voters!
notes.notes:
I wanted to personally say Thank You! to all the people who voted "Highly Anticipated" for the steam awards! 

While the game is being worked on I have been trying out a few different ways to market and expand for the games reach, some people may not agree that voting for the game yet is a good idea since it's not released. You are well within your rights to have that opinion, please do not go vomiting all over our page(s) expressing that though. (yes we have had trolls go and vomit the same thing over and over on different social media pages, business pages, etc.)

As a solo indie developer I spend a lot of time working on this game alone so it means a great deal to me, not to mention this is a business and yes those sort of comments do damage reputation and future customers, so no we do not tolerate trolls in any fashion.

To the people who voted, again thank you so much! I will announce the winner of the giveaway shortly :D good luck!
